components.name: BaseButton
components.description:
Base button component with theme support and click feedback.
Renders as an anchor tag if href is provided, otherwise as a button.
Features visual feedback on click with theme-specific styling.

props.name: href
props.description: Link URL (renders as anchor tag if provided)

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for screen readers and scrapers

props.name: data-contact
props.description: Machine-readable contact type for scrapers (e.g. gitlab, linkedin, email)

Reveal
components.description:
Reveal component that animates content when it enters the viewport.
Supports fade, slide, and zoom animation types with configurable direction and timing.
Uses Intersection Observer for efficient viewport detection.

props.name: distance
props.description: Distance in pixels for slide animations

props.name: type
props.description: Animation type: fade, slide, or zoom

props.name: once
props.description: If true, animation only plays once when element enters viewport

components.name: RevealStagger
components.description:
Reveal component that animates multiple children with staggered timing.
Each child receives an incremental delay based on the interval parameter.
Useful for creating cascading reveal effects.

props.name: children
props.description: Children to animate with staggered timing

props.name: delay
props.description: Base delay before first animation starts

props.name: interval
props.description: Time interval between each child's animation

props.name: type
props.description: Animation type: fade, slide, or zoom

props.name: distance
props.description: Distance in pixels for slide animations

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the container

props.name: revealClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the reveal items
